embedded_build_options.comment: The slice of Dolphin an embedding build compiles: Core and its dependency graph, with no frontend and no unrelated audio or video backends. Read by cmake/DolphinDependency.cmake and tools/gcnport_tools/dolphin_runtime.py, which is why it lives here instead of being written out twice. ENABLE_TESTS is absent on purpose: the standalone runtime build turns it ON for Dolphin's own gtest binary, and the adapter build leaves it OFF.
